# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old
- **Gender:** male
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight lad with a round, expressionless face and a wide, freckle-covered face.

_Sources: [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Barney has very little capacity for chatter or laughter and possesses an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. He is extremely timid and bashful, though he possesses good sense. When addressed, he lets out quiet laughs and smiles joyfully. After his marriage, a strange possessive tendency surfaced in his character.

_Sources: [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v4 c18 P47](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0047)_

## Traits

- emotionless
- timid  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- bashful  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- hardworking  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- reliable  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- possessive  <sub>[v4 c18 P47](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0047)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Barney Pullen drove a double-seated buggy alongside his sister Odette to transport Nell Harcourt and Isolde to an event in Pale Sands, feeling immense pride in traveling beside Nell, whom he vastly admired. During a gathering with the local youth, he occupied a corner all night, observing Nell with a joyful smile. Having been given the upper farm by his father, Barney sought to marry Nell, but his extreme bashfulness led him to incessantly persuade Odette to propose on his behalf. After Nell firmly rejected the proposal, Barney quickly turned his attention to Nettie Scobie, whom he subsequently married, entering the Gorham Pullen pew with his new bride glowing with satisfaction and joy.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
